name.zh: Atlas 900 A3 超节点 / CloudMatrix384（384 NPU，两级 UB 交换）
name.en: Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD / CloudMatrix384 (384 NPUs, two-level UB switching)

name.zh: 每 NPU 2 × 200G、64 口交换机、无收敛折叠 Clos（HAC-D 模板默认，主算例）
name.en: 2 × 200G per NPU, 64-port switches, non-blocking folded Clos (HAC-D template default, main case)

basis.zh: 论文：每 die 1 个 RDMA 口、每 NPU 400 Gb/s；端口数 64 与无收敛为假设；与另一份《950 与 910C》报告相同
basis.en: paper: one RDMA port per die, 400 Gb/s per NPU; radix 64 and non-blocking assumed; the same as in the other “950 and 910C” report

basis.zh: 现行 51.2T 交换芯片按 200G 口使用（假设）
basis.en: a current 51.2T switch chip used with 200G ports (assumed)

basis.zh: 第三方 800I A3 规格：每台 8 × 400GE；FiberMall 转述 SemiAnalysis：每 CM384 scale-out 1,536 只模块 = 384 网卡 + 768 叶 + 384 脊
basis.en: third-party 800I A3 listing: 8 × 400GE per server; FiberMall relaying SemiAnalysis: 1,536 scale-out modules per CM384 = 384 NIC + 768 leaf + 384 spine

name.zh: 主算例 + 叶层 2:1 收敛
name.en: main case with 2:1 at the leaves

superpod.source: Huawei, Serving Large Language Models on Huawei CloudMatrix384 (arXiv 2506.12708 v3) §3.3: 48 nodes × (8 NPUs + 4 CPUs + 7 L1 UB chips), 12 compute + 4 communication cabinets, 7 sub-planes × 16 L2 chips

superpod.transceiversPerLink.source: one module per L1–L2 link end (SemiAnalysis counts 6,912 × 400G LPO per system on another basis)

domainNpus.source: arXiv 2506.12708 v3 §3.3 (384 NPUs in one UB domain)

scaleOut.portsPerNpu.source: arXiv 2506.12708 v3: one RDMA port per die, 400 Gb/s per NPU

scaleOut.radix.source: 64-port switches, non-blocking folded Clos (radix not public)

assumed.zh: 每条 L1–L2 光链路 2 只光模块（SemiAnalysis 另一口径为每系统 6,912 只 400G LPO）
assumed.en: 2 transceivers per L1–L2 optical link (SemiAnalysis: 6,912 × 400G LPO per system on another basis)

assumed.zh: 112 片 L2 芯片均分到 4 个通信柜（每柜 28 片；布局未公开）
assumed.en: the 112 L2 chips spread evenly over the 4 communication cabinets (28 each; placement not public)

assumed.zh: scale-out：每 die 1 个 200G RDMA 口（论文：每 NPU 400 Gb/s）接 64 口无收敛折叠 Clos（radix 未公开）
assumed.en: scale-out: one 200G RDMA port per die (paper: 400 Gb/s per NPU) into a non-blocking folded Clos of 64-port switches (radix not public)

ubLabel.zh: L1（节点内 7 片）/ L2（通信柜）两级 UB 交换 + 光链路
ubLabel.en: two-level UB switching, L1 (7 per node) / L2 (comm cabinets) + optics

podLabel.zh: 超节点 384 NPU：12 计算柜 + 4 通信柜
